trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex lateral trajectory that curves sharply upward into acute distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular protrusions and surface deformations on the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting significant barnacle colonization or localized physical trauma.
